recommended_build_phases: Phase 1 — Canonical foundation closeout: requirement reconciliation, Viewer performance, unified intake, V5.2 design system/shell/state.
Phase 2 — Production completion: BOM & Machines/routing, Workbench + Manufacturing Geometry Interpreter, manufacturing chain, Profile/Plate Nesting, converter.
Phase 3 — Documents/Control/Operations: vector drawing/Trusted & External PDF, Print Center, Validation/Evidence, Quality, Planning/Shopfloor, Export/Reports, all V5 surfaces.
Phase 4 — Total acceptance & exact-SHA Windows release: UI/control/visual/E2E/performance/Trimble/negative/persistence/stress + one-folder/portable/installer/SBOM/checksums/source bundle.
